objective: Single RTX 4090 geometry research: VGGT-Omega initial geometry -> trusted geometry correction -> differentiable mesh/SDF -> UV, with cross-scene evidence at every stage.

hardware.training_policy: no VGGT-Omega training or fine-tuning under any circumstance
hardware.resource_policy: long runs in tmux with logs on disk; do not kill other users' jobs; prefer microbatch/resolution reduction before deep tuning

gates.vggt_inference_valid: checkpoint sha256 matches; 16-view export contract complete

phases.name: cross-scene baselines and unified evaluation
phases.note: ETH3D is internal geometry evaluation until the official visibility protocol is implemented.

arms.G3: URGT small-scale high-resolution local normal correction (Lego, relief, 2-4 prior views)

phases.name: ExMesh E0-E3 ablation
phases.arms: E0-E3; separate initialization quality from optimization supervision; Lego first, then relief

phases.name: Mesh Splatting
phases.pipeline: DMTet -> softening -> remeshing -> export; one scene first; stop-loss to ExMesh split/merge on overrun

env.name: 3dtex
env.pytorch3d: source build 0.7.9; quaternion_to_matrix CUDA forward verified
env.exmesh_extensions: simple-knn and diff-plane-rasterization built; build_rotation quaternion forward verified

phase1.primary_metric: F-score at 1 voxel, observed GT depth points, frozen 0.01150144350298549 m grid

peak_sampling.method: external nvidia-smi memory.used polling every 30 ms; peak minus idle; per-process query unsupported in container

scenes.gt: rendered observed GT depth from the same 16 views
scenes.label: internal_p0

phase2_protocol.heldout_policy: heldout images never enter VGGT, TSDF, mesh optimisation or geometry metrics; reserved for phase 6 appearance
phase2_protocol.gt_isolation: GT cameras, scan, rendered depth and foreground masks are read only by evaluation; reconstruction inputs limited to dataset images and VGGT outputs

arms.B0: raw VGGT depth/confidence -> train-only Sim(3) -> TSDF uniform weights, nearest sampling, no filter, no carving (no GT)
arms.B1: consistency_filter (no masks, tau_abs=1% camera span, tau_rel=0.05, min_agree=2, no confidence cut) -> confidence-weighted TSDF, nearest (no GT)
arms.B1_legacy: Lego v35c30 free-space carving with GT foreground masks + confidence fusion; diagnostic only, GT-assisted, excluded from cross-scene gates

lego.rule: assert frozen values for B0/B1/B1_legacy; never recompute

eth3d.reuse_rule: B1 and all phase-3 G arms pass --roi-geometry <B0 omega>; voxel/shape mismatch invalidates the run
eth3d.forbidden: no GT-derived grid (no GT camera bbox, no scan bbox)

metrics.evaluator: scripts/eval_point_metrics.py (implemented and synthetically self-tested 2026-11-04: offset 0.01 -> chamfer 0.010715; Sim(3) scale 1.3 recovered as 1.3000000000000005)
metrics.alignment: train-only Sim(3) from predicted camera centres to GT camera centres; scale applied to depth and mesh; no per-view scale/shift
metrics.sampling: 50k fixed-seed area-weighted mesh samples; 50k fixed-seed GT samples
metrics.accuracy: mean nearest distance mesh samples -> GT point set
metrics.completeness: mean nearest distance GT samples -> mesh samples
metrics.chamfer: symmetric mean of accuracy and completeness
metrics.fscore: F1 at 1 P0 voxel and F2 at 2 voxels
metrics.threshold_units: Lego uses the P0 voxel directly (GT gauge); ETH3D uses P0 voxel x Sim(3) scale and records scale in surface_metrics.json
metrics.lego_secondary: Blender measure_surfaces triangle-exact metrics and normal error for phase-1 continuity
metrics.output: outputs/72h/<scene>_<arm>/surface_metrics.json with grid and GT sample hashes

run_validity: VGGT manifest frames and checkpoint sha256 match, no NaN depth
mesh exists with >1000 vertices and >0 triangles, no NaN/Inf
voxel and shape match the frozen grid
single scene arm <=30 min and nvidia-smi peak delta <=10 GB
batch, peak VRAM, sps, gate verdict and log path recorded
gates.b1_improves_scene: chamfer relative decrease >=2% AND f1 absolute increase >=0.005
gates.b1_cross_scene: improvement on >=2/3 ETH3D scenes AND on Lego
gates.degradation_guard: any scene with chamfer degradation >5% or f1 drop >0.02 fails the overall gate
gates.lego_absolute_floor: B1 chamfer <=0.0135 and F1 >=0.62 (not relaxed when GT masks are removed; failure recorded as a negative result)
gates.eth3d_absolute: no pre-declared absolute floor; first B0 values are descriptive baseline under the same protocol

eth3d.notes: completeness uses the full scan without official visibility masking, so numbers are conservative and never compared with the official leaderboard

p0_grids.source: B0 raw VGGT depth only (no GT-derived grid)

lego_relative.why: chamfer -0.84% below the 2% bar and inside the M2 repeat floor

invalid_runs: relief B1 attempt 1: far derived from filtered median -> voxel 0.04536, shape [129,187,171]; GRID_MATCH assertion failed, arm deleted and re-run with B0 depth_near/depth_far
pipes attempt 1: GT concat passed str to read_ply -> AttributeError; no metrics produced, fixed by Path coercion
phase2_results.phase3: may start only as B0-controlled exploration; B1 is not a valid default arm (1/3 ETH3D, pipes degradation)

kicker.verdict: method issue: raw-VGGT background shell, 89% mesh samples >2 vox from scan

pipes.verdict: method issue: B1 drops 60.6% surface area; chamfer +138%

calibration.eth3d_f1: not usable as a gate without official visibility masking (ROI 1-vox recall 0.015-0.031)

gates.overall: FAIL: no arm beats the 4090 M2 floor (0.009414)

invalid_runs: calibration kicker attempt 1: pre-Sim3 mesh bbox -> empty ROI -> percentile crash; fixed
evaluate.py with >2 meshes: Blender exits after ~2 cases on 2M-triangle source; re-ran per mesh
URGT body: no code/weights locally or on remote; only a labelled high-res normal-correction proxy ran
phase3_results.phase4: E0 may start; E1-E3 blocked by background-shell suppression and ETH3D visibility protocol
